review_note: Board ESG task enters annual variable-remuneration assessment; exact weight and payout effect remain undisclosed.
Transition plan is explicitly connected to business and investment-plan approval; no claim is made about effectiveness of each project.
Expected taxonomy alignment is linked to the 2025–2030 investment plan; treated as planned allocation rather than realised impact.
ESG-related KPIs materially affect variable remuneration; exact ESG proportion within the qualitative component is limited.
Reasonable assurance supports the defined financed-emissions calculation methodology. It does not support a claim of portfolio decarbonisation.
Energy monitoring is linked to server and data-centre upgrades; project-level savings and investment values are not disclosed.
Taxonomy information is linked to company decisions and quantified through aligned CapEx and OpEx; no whole-company sustainability inference.
GreenFuture is presented as a management and control system across product, production and retail; detailed site-level outcomes remain outside the segment.
Life-cycle product management explicitly covers own and supplier production, use and end-of-life; reduced life-cycle impact is not assumed.
